datasets.title: Course 1 Synthetic Traceability and Reconciliation Exercise
datasets.description: Synthetic instructional event records for identity preservation, movement genealogy, reconciliation, discrepancy handling, and shift handoff. No real facility, crop, person, or regulatory record is represented.

provenance.reviewNotes: Purpose-built synthetic training data. Approved for instructional use because all identities, events, timestamps, quantities, and discrepancies are fictional and deterministic; it must never be presented as empirical or regulatory data.

datasets.notes: Designed to exercise record genealogy and reconciliation without importing an unrelated external dataset merely to satisfy a count target.
